facts.fact: Via Ruggiero Settimo leads from the Politeama area to Teatro Massimo; Via Maqueda continues toward Quattro Canti.
facts.excerpt: Via Ruggiero Settimo (named after the late 19th-century politician) takes us, amidst the shop windows of hundreds of shops and the crowds of Palermitani engaged in shopping or strolling, to the Teatro Massimo

facts.fact: Quattro Canti has four decorated facades and is octagonal.
facts.excerpt: Piazza Vigliena , known as the Quattro Canti , is octagonal with four richly decorated and quite striking facades.

facts.fact: From the junction the Cathedral and Royal Palace lie up the Cassaro, while Piazza Pretoria is reached along the other axis.
facts.excerpt: going to the right we can climb up to the Cathedral and the Palazzo Reale

facts.fact: The official walking route links Piazza Pretoria to Quattro Canti.
facts.excerpt: while proceeding straight on, we reach Piazza Pretoria

title: Visit Sicily — walking Palermo historic centre
